scope: dev15 design set only; INDICATIVE. Candidate = deterministic path (T-new). Baseline = the stored B1a 7B pilot rows scored by the research-only lexical scorer (read, not re-run). dev16 untouched.

criteria.name: unsupported material claims reduced >=30% with no increase in severe
criteria.what_is_missing: candidate side deterministic (leaks are 0 by state); BASELINE side needs the P0 arm (a 7B run on dev16, separate approval) AND a measure of P0's free-text leaks: the lexical scorer is research-only and failed validation, so the P0 replies need blinded manual adjudication

criteria.name: false abstention: <=1 additional AND <=3 pp among answerable sub-claims
criteria.what_is_missing: candidate side deterministic; BASELINE side as criterion 1

criteria.name: supported sub-claim recall >=90% of baseline
criteria.what_is_missing: candidate side deterministic; BASELINE side as criterion 1

criteria.name: fully correct mixed questions: one-sided 95% lower bound >= 70% AND paired non-regression vs baseline
criteria.measured: 87% (26/30); one-sided 95% lower bound 73%; paired: lost 1, gained 11
criteria.note: research acceptance threshold, not proof of production safety
criteria.what_is_missing: candidate side deterministic; the paired non-regression part needs P0 per-question correctness (as criterion 1)

criteria.name: zero accepted nonexistent or unauthorised citations
criteria.what_is_missing: fully deterministic (manifest check); no baseline needed

criteria.name: >=95% citation-support correctness, claim level, with a minimum of 40 eligible cited factual claims
criteria.note: the floor is a minimum for evaluation, not proof of a low error rate
criteria.what_is_missing: containment and gold-source membership are deterministic; whether a context-, title- or speaker-bound record SUPPORTS the claim is semantic and needs a manual sample (all non-direct bindings plus 30 direct)

criteria.name: no unsupported conflict resolution
criteria.note: 0 events in 19 independent opportunities; one-sided 95% upper bound 15%; INSUFFICIENT COVERAGE: zero observed events here is not evidence of production safety
criteria.what_is_missing: fully deterministic; coverage (conflict atoms) is the open question, as before

criteria.name: no absence claim justified solely by unsuccessful retrieval
criteria.note: 0 events in 6 independent opportunities; one-sided 95% upper bound 39%; INSUFFICIENT COVERAGE: zero observed events here is not evidence of production safety
criteria.what_is_missing: fully deterministic; coverage is the open question (the corpus v5 existence worlds give 64 more facts)

criteria.name: no invented temporal supersession
criteria.note: 0 events in 9 independent opportunities; one-sided 95% upper bound 28%; INSUFFICIENT COVERAGE: zero observed events here is not evidence of production safety
criteria.what_is_missing: fully deterministic (ordering needs an explicit supersession or explicit effective periods by construction); coverage is the open question

criteria.name: no more than one net loss of fully correct answers vs baseline
criteria.what_is_missing: candidate side deterministic; BASELINE side as criterion 1
